root = Stack([header, summaryGrid, mainTabs], 16)
header = Text("Recent Transactions", "heading")
txns = Query("host_listTransactions", {limit: 50}, {data: [], total: 0})
spending = Query("host_getSpendingInsights", {}, [])
recurring = Query("host_getRecurringInsights", {}, [])
txnData = txns.data
totalSpend = @Sum(txnData.amount)
txnAvg = @Avg(txnData.amount)
statTotal = Stat("Total Volume", totalSpend, "money")
statCount = Stat("Transactions Count", txns.total, "number")
statAvg = Stat("Average Transaction", txnAvg, "money")
statsStack = Stack([statBalance, statTotal, statCount, statAvg], 12)
summaryCard = Surface([statsStack], "Summary")
chartComp = DonutChart(spending, "category", "amount", "money")
chartCard = Surface([chartComp], "Spending Breakdown")
summaryGrid = Grid([summaryCard, chartCard], 2, 16)
recurringCols = [{key: "merchant", label: "Merchant"}, {key: "category", label: "Category", format: "label"}, {key: "cadence", label: "Cadence", format: "label"}, {key: "nextDate", label: "Next Date", format: "date"}, {key: "amount", label: "Amount", format: "money", align: "end"}]
recurringTable = DataTable(recurring, recurringCols, "nextDate asc", 20, ["category"], false, 10, "No recurring charges detected")
recurringCard = Surface([recurringTable], "Upcoming Recurring Charges")
tab1 = {label: "All Transactions", content: tab1Stack}
tab2 = {label: "Recurring Charges", content: recurringCard}
mainTabs = Tabs([tab1, tab2])
barChartComp = DonutChart(spending, "category", "amount", "money")
barChartCard = Surface([barChartComp], "Spending by Category")
tab1Stack = Stack([barChartCard, cashflowCard], 16)
accounts = Query("host_listAccounts", {}, [])
totalBalance = @Sum(accounts.balance)
statBalance = Stat("Total Account Balance", totalBalance, "money", null, "accent")
cashflow = Query("host_getCashflowInsights", {}, [])
cashflowSeries = [{key: "in", label: "Inflow"}, {key: "out", label: "Outflow"}]
cashflowChart = LineChart(cashflow, "label", cashflowSeries, "money")
cashflowCard = Surface([cashflowChart], "Cashflow Trends")
